[SWS_CM_10169] Missing parameters
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00202
⌈
To allow migration the deserialization shall ignore parameters attached to the end of
previously known parameter list.
⌋
This means: Parameters that were not defined in the
ServiceInterface
used to
generate or parametrize the deserialization code but exist at the end of the serialized
data will be ignored by the deserialization.
